item.title: Massachusetts Governor Healey files legislation to keep ICE out of certain areas, signs executive order banning ICE from making civil arrests in certain locations
item.description: BOSTON – Governor Maura Healey today filed legislation to keep ICE out of courthouses, schools, child care programs, hospitals and churches; make it unlawful for another state to deploy its National Guard in Massachusetts without the Governor’s permission; and allow parents to pre-arrange guardianship for their children in case they are detained or deported.
